matcher-transaction.actual_behavior: Default Match preflights the WHOLE pattern with capture=false, then runs it with capture enabled only after success. A failed whole Match does not alter capture pointers. A successful Match followed by a false C++ conjunct DOES retain captures.

matcher-any-order.actual_behavior: Normal non-explaining AnyOrder tries pattern1->operand0/pattern2->operand1 first, then swapped. It preflights each orientation without capture. Later caller predicates do not backtrack into this choice.

matcher-one-use.actual_behavior: WithOneUse requires exactly one user AND exactly one occurrence in that user operands. user_count()==1 alone permits repeated occurrences.

IsAll.actual_behavior: UnwrapToConstant follows operand0 through Broadcast, Copy, DynamicSlice, Reshape, Reverse, Slice, Transpose; then literal.IsAll(value). Literal overload CHECKs scalar. This is the source storage/view test, not universal mathematical evaluation.

IsNonNegative.actual_behavior: Keep pinned source switch/recursion, including Exp=true, unsigned/nonsigned Abs=true, same-input nonsigned Multiply=true; constants reject negative-sign/NaN; Maximum uses OR; default delegates to pinned IsPositive. This predicate is not a theorem of nonnegativity or non-NaN.

compatible-existing.actual_behavior: Reject nonempty old control predecessors or !SameShape. Otherwise visitor existing replacement preserve_sharding=true, preserve_frontend_attributes=true, then StatusOr.value(): false may continue, non-OK value access is fatal rather than propagated handler Status.

visitor-new.actual_behavior: Default preserve_sharding=false, relay_controls=false, remove_unused=true, preserve_frontend_attributes=true. Calls computation-new; any OK marks changed=true, including low-level unchanged/skip OK.

visitor-existing.actual_behavior: Existing replacement relays controls=true, remove_unused=true; explicit preserve flags. StatusOr overload ORs changed with returned bool. Status overload uses preserve_sharding=false, DCHECKs successful bool, returns status.
